description_text: Proposed procurement for NSN 5330012456486 SEAL,NONMETALLIC SP: Line 0001 Qty 143 UI EA Deliver To: By: 0126 DAYS ADO This Solicitation may result in an Automated IDC (Indefinite Delivery Contract). The term of the contract/order will be one year or until the aggregate total of orders placed against the contract/order reach 350000.00. The estimated number of orders per year is 12. The Guaranteed Minimum quantity will be 21. Items will be shipped to various CONUS and OCONUS (via consolidation and containerization point) DLA Depots. Approved sources are 02921 SS2942-84; 54878 SS2942-84; 75183 SS2942-84; 78286 SS2942-84. The solicitation is an RFQ and will be available at the link provided in this notice. Hard copies of this solicitation are not available. Specifications, plans, or drawings are not available. All responsible sources may submit a quote which, if timely received, shall be considered. Quotes must be submitted electronically.
